title: fleet-guards: helper stderr discarded (2>/dev/null) makes new WARNs undiagnosable
description: Codereview of 2ehk (edge pass, kimi-k3). fleet-guards.sh:95 (and parse at :96) discard stderr, so the WARN messages say THAT the helper failed but the traceback that would say WHY is gone. Log shows 'no output / not valid JSON' every 10 min with zero evidence. Fix: capture stderr to a logfile under $STATE (or let it through to the loop's stderr) so the WARN is actionable.
close_reason: Fixed: fleet_burn.py stderr now captured to $STATE/fleet_burn.err (overwritten each cycle) instead of /dev/null; both WARN branches append the last stderr line inline and the full-log path, making the failure diagnosable from the log alone. Verified with 5-case stub smoke: missing helper (errno hint inline), synthetic crash (hint 'boom: synthetic crash'), garbage JSON (WARN not-JSON), real-helper legit skip (silent), evaluated:true (normal path). bash -n clean; fleet_burn 12/12 still pass.
